_comment: Researched extras merged on top of the Google Sheet at import time, keyed by vendor slug (see slugs in vendors.json). The Sheet stays the source for core facts; this holds neighbor reviews, logos, and Yelp ratings gathered separately. Reviews below were drawn from the Pomeroy West Google Group and scrubbed of names/addresses/phones for privacy.

reviews.text: We went with Glen from Anderson Radiant and I can't recommend him enough — incredibly responsive and worked around our schedule. The whole job took about a day and a half, with the final half-day spent thoroughly checking the system and walking us through how everything works. The craftsmanship is truly like a “piece of art” — everything neatly labeled, with all the documentation for our records.
reviews.author: A Pomeroy West neighbor

reviews.text: I switched to a combi boiler system and used Glen with Anderson Radiant — he took over for his grandfather and specializes in water-based radiant heating systems.
reviews.author: A Pomeroy West neighbor
